nodes.rationale: Memgraph community is BSL 1.1; the packages/graph adapter keeps Neo4j Community as a drop-in to mitigate redistribution constraints (risk R-003).

nodes.label: llama.cpp server (LLM serving, CPU fallback)
nodes.rationale: CPU fallback for vLLM so air-gapped and GPU-less deployments still run the assistant; the dev stack runs Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct on it.

nodes.label: k6 (performance tests, AGPL, subprocess)
nodes.rationale: k6 is AGPL-3.0, so it runs only as a separate subprocess invoked from tools/perf and is never linked (risk R-006).
